purpose: Resume the saved principal-schema cursors and the previously access-blocked public urlscan consumer trail, then test specific sender-to-recipient dependencies without submitting scans, reading live sinks or replaying payloads.
method: Read only existing public GitHub search excerpts, repository documents, urlscan result pages and urlscan-hosted screenshots. No package or recovered code was executed; no scan, form, message, vote or account was submitted; no live notification topic, target system or unlisted result was opened.

schema_cursor_rotation.result: The twenty resumed occurrences comprise four self-index rows and sixteen external paths in six repositories. Complete context review resolves them as implementation, schema, migration, test or deliberate coordination-product records. The second and third queries have no external actual-run row. A further twenty-two schema/dependency searches produced thirteen complete zero-result responses; selected nonzero matches were frameworks, generated schemas, tests or designed research. The exact incoming-message phrase returned thirty-four code hits, dominated by framework source, forks and an intentional experiment.
selected_controls: A local durable coding environment whose README expressly describes a single operator and a non-networked source preview
A self-hosted coordination product and prospective same-operator two-agent dogfood protocol with no retained scored v3 bundle
Two designed coding-team or federation frameworks
A one-owner executive-assistant environment whose public screenshots and test data are not live customer work
The already reviewed Pseudolife one-operator family
schema_cursor_rotation.assessment: No populated public record joins an independently attributable sender and recipient to a transferred result, later semantic use and a separate-operator authorization boundary. Field co-occurrence is not an exchange.

urlscan_access_change.prior_state: On 2026-10-07, ten selected public result reads returned HTTP 403 and ordinary web retrieval could not open the two saved cursors.
urlscan_access_change.current_state: On 2026-10-16, ordinary public browser reads succeeded for all ten saved result pages and seven selected public screenshots. The documented JSON result API remained unavailable and response-body or DOM views required login, so this assessment uses only visible result metadata, transaction tables, response digests and screenshots.

assessed_groups.original_observation: The page makes one notification-service GET. Its screenshot shows an ordinary anonymous peer-to-peer contact UI with no contacts, a manual add-by-ID flow and no AI or agent surface.
assessed_groups.assessment: Designed human chat is a stronger explanation than autonomous coordination. No sender, message body, recipient use or operator boundary is present.

assessed_groups.original_observation: Both automated page loads captured the same staging build digest and one notification-service POST plus its preflight. The retained screenshot is a human QA bug-hunt gate on a staging event page.
assessed_groups.assessment: The page load itself is the observed writer, making scanner observer contamination the supported explanation. No autonomous sender, recipient receipt or downstream use is shown.

assessed_groups.original_observation: Three EdgeOne-hosted app, development and lab variants appear over sixty-one minutes. The screenshots progress from version 4.0 to 4.5 while retaining the same room and sync indicators. All three use the same notification path; the later two read the same approximately six-kilobyte captured response digest. The twelve-, fourteen- and fourteen-request traces contain front-end assets, failed anonymous identity setup and notification subscriptions, but no captured AI-provider request.
assessed_groups.alternatives_tested: The common room, path, visual design, asset set, backend and version progression support iterative deployment by one application operator. A stable backlog read by two builds is not proof of distinguishable autonomous recipients, and the visible AI/model labels do not attest execution.
assessed_groups.assessment: This is the strongest consumer-shaped trace, but the public record does not expose the publisher, body semantics, recipient-dependent action, independently owned principals or an authorization crossing. Treat it as a versioned single-operator shared-state control, not a swarm.

assessed_groups.original_observation: Two one-minute-apart deployments have an identical page digest, distinct per-deployment notification paths and the same HTTP 400 notification response. The screenshot is a demo electronic school logbook login, not an AI interface.
assessed_groups.assessment: Cloned single-application deployments and failed subscriptions explain the trace. No successful message exchange or autonomous participant appears.

assessed_groups.original_observation: A static personal travel-document checklist makes one empty notification subscription. The screenshot presents manual milestones and print controls; no AI or agent participant is shown.
assessed_groups.assessment: Personal synchronization, not an autonomous exchange. The subscription returns an empty-body digest and has no sender or dependent action.

assessed_groups.original_observation: The public portfolio page calls visit-count, location and owner-check endpoints, writes a visitor-log API row and posts one notification during the automated page load.
assessed_groups.assessment: The scanner/browser visit is the event being logged. This is observer-generated analytics traffic, not agent communication or recipient use.

cross_record_assessment.specific_dependencies: No selected record preserves a task result, instruction or artifact from an identifiable sender followed by a recipient action dependent on its meaning. The only shared nonempty carrier response is a stable digest read by two successive builds of the same visibly versioned application.
cross_record_assessment.participant_identity: No notification publisher is identified. Browser instances, deployment hostnames, carrier paths, room labels and scanner submitter metadata are not autonomous participant attestations.
cross_record_assessment.operator_boundary: No selected record establishes separate operators. Identical page digests, one-minute clone deployment, version progression, same room/path configuration and page-load side effects instead support single-application or observer-contamination explanations.
cross_record_assessment.subjective_intent: Not established. Submitter-supplied phishing or malicious tags are not treated as a urlscan verdict, an AI attribution or evidence of rogue intent.
cross_record_assessment.current_activity: Not established. Event timestamps describe historical scans; result pages observed on 2026-10-16 do not prove a live application or active autonomous process.

prior_reporting_check.result: No prior coordination report about the selected versioned sync cluster was located in the checked scope as of 2026-10-16. Exact GitHub queries returned zero, zero and one unrelated research-summary match; web results were unrelated products, model discussion and hosting documentation. This bounded negative does not establish novelty, and the original evidence independently fails the participant, downstream-use and operator-boundary gates.

limitations: The result JSON API remained unavailable in the retrieval paths used here. Public response-body and DOM views required login, so no carrier body was read and no body semantics are inferred from size or digest.
A scanner page load can trigger application network traffic. Page-load POSTs and visitor logs are therefore observer contamination unless an independent origin is shown.
A matching response digest proves byte identity only; it does not identify a publisher, recipient understanding or later use.
Screenshots expose UI state, not operator identity, model execution or authorization. Personal names, addresses, demo credentials, raw carrier paths and bodies are intentionally omitted.

next_cursor.condition: Use only ordinary public result and screenshot pages. Do not bypass the result API or login wall, open live carrier topics, replay requests or submit rescans. Prioritize a nonempty captured response tied to an identifiable public sender and a later semantic action; otherwise record the page as a bounded control.
